meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会帮你规划、配置、检查、重启并分析 FluidSim 流体仿真:按物理问题选求解器(2D/3D 纳维-斯托克斯、浅水、分层流),生成参数与运行代码,并读取输出画图、做数值有效性与 HPC 安全检查。
howto.when: 当你想规划或配置流体模拟、选择 FluidSim 求解器、核对参数与 FFT/MPI 设置,或要求输出诊断、重启仿真时,Claude 会接管处理。

say.text: 帮我用 ns2d 配一个 2D 湍流模拟,256 网格,粘性 1e-3
say.note: 生成可运行的参数与启动代码

say.text: 跑完后把能量谱和涡量场画出来
say.note: 会读取输出并调用绘图接口

say.text: 用 mpirun 跑 512³ 的 3D 仿真,参数怎么改?
say.note: 给出 MPI 启动方式和参数设置

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations: pick a solver (2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified), generate parameters and run code, and read outputs for plotting and numerical/HPC safety checks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan or configure a fluid simulation, choose a FluidSim solver, review parameters or FFT/MPI setup, or request output diagnostics or a restart.

say_en.text: Set up a 2D turbulence run with ns2d, 256 grid, viscosity 1e-3
say_en.note: Returns runnable params and start code

say_en.text: Plot the energy spectrum and vorticity after the run
say_en.note: Reads outputs and calls plotting functions

say_en.text: What parameters do I need for a 512^3 3D run with mpirun?
say_en.note: Gives MPI command and parameter settings
